items.text_th:
คำโปรโมต = เข้าพักโรงแรมสุดหรู มี NPC พนักงานใหม่ต้อนรับ
เล่นจริง = เป็นแม่บ้านโรงแรม  มี NPC ที่เป็นแขกจิกหัวใช้
ชาวเกาะไกอา ดีใจโรงแรมหรู พากันแต่ตัวเป็นคุณหญิงคุณนายเข้าพัก
พอเข้าไปปุ้ป เป็นแม่บ้าน เหิ้ยมาก
items.text_vn:
Quảng cáo = vào ở khách sạn sang trọng, có NPC nhân viên mới chào đón.
Chơi thật = làm quản gia khách sạn, có NPC khách sai bảo như osin.
Dân đảo Kaia mừng vì khách sạn sang, rủ nhau ăn mặc như quý bà vào ở.
Vào rồi hóa ra làm người dọn phòng, quá đáng thật.
items.text_en:
Promo = stay in a luxury hotel with new NPC staff welcoming you.
Reality = you are the hotel maid and NPC guests order you around.
Kaia islanders got excited and dressed up like fancy ladies to check in.
Then you walk in and you're the maid. So unfair.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi so sánh quảng cáo (ở khách sạn sang) với thực tế (làm quản gia bị NPC sai bảo).
items.summary_en: A player contrasts the promo (a luxury hotel stay) with the reality (working as the maid for bossy NPCs).
items.theme: Góp ý trải nghiệm chung
items.topic: Other
